posts.title: Teaching Whisper to speak Australian at Everything Open 2026
posts.description: If you run Home Assistant locally, Whisper is doing your speech recognition, and it doesn't always understand Australian voices. At Everything Open 2026 I ran a tutorial on fine-tuning Whisper with Australian English from Mozilla Common Voice, and the video is now online.

posts.title: OpenAI’s new device is a data capture tool, because we’ve reached Peak Token
posts.description: Much has been made of the recent announcement of the collaboration between OpenAI co-founder Sam Altman and Apple design guru Jony Ive on a new hardware device (Jess Weatherbed, The Verge), and speculation has followed on the form it might take (Ryan Morrison, Tom's Hardware)…

posts.title: Book review: Technocolonialism by Mirca Madianou
